name: ytarr
install: cd /agent/repos/ytarr && sudo apt-get update && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3.12-venv ffmpeg && python3 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && npm --prefix frontend ci

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: ytarr Vite/React dev server on http://localhost:5173 (proxies /api to :8199)
